headline: Commands, joins, and sticker reports
intro: This release tightens everyday group behaviour. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Command menu
Tapping a suggestion such as /help in a group now runs correctly when Telegram inserts the bot username (/help@BotName).
Telegram bots
Bots you add from BotFather are no longer kicked on join. Join verification still applies to people. Raidmode still stops flood joins, not official bots.
Member status
/stats (reply or @username) now shows immune, trusted, approved, and sticker warnings as separate fields.
Sticker reports

A /report now bans that sticker and its pack, and is enforced for members and admins. Only the owner can /unreport or /unreportall confirm. Removal notices tag the sender; rapid spam is grouped into one message.
Admin demote
Three banned-sticker warnings still demote an admin this bot promoted with /makeadmin. The next banned sticker after that is a kick.

headline: Hand cricket and game cards
intro: This update is about match rules and how games look in the group. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Hand cricket
If you are out for 0, the other side only needs 1 to win. The chase now ends as soon as that target is passed — they do not keep batting to 18. Your number locks for that ball and cannot be changed.
Scoreboard cards
Cricket, toss, lucky 7, and duels post a graphic card with both player names, score, and who is batting.

headline: New games and per-game boards
intro: Three new two-player games, and a wins/losses board for each game. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Four in a row
/four @username — a visible board. Drop in columns 1–7. First to four in a line wins.
Penalty duel
/penalty — five kicks each. Shooter and keeper pick Left, Centre, or Right. Same side is a save.
The vault
/vault — both lock Share or Take. Split, steal, or both walk away empty.
Per-game leaderboard
/top cricket, /top four, /top penalty, and the other games show wins, losses, and draws. /balance lists your line for each.

headline: Games removed for a rebuild
intro: All games, coins, and per-game boards are removed while they get rebuilt cleanly. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Games and leaderboard
Daily bonus, toss, dice, lucky 7, hand cricket, four in a row, penalty duel, the vault, balances, and every leaderboard are gone for now. This clears out bugs found in the old game engine.
Everything else
Moderation, verify, notes, whisper, scold, and the calculator are unaffected.

headline: Makeadmin now works on bots
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Promoting a bot
/makeadmin can now promote a bot the same way it promotes a person - reply to it or tag it. It still only touches admins it promoted itself.

headline: Admin roles for makeadmin
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Choose what a new admin can do

/makeadmin @username now takes an optional role: helper (delete + pin only), mod (adds mute/ban/kick, invite, video chats - this is the default), or admin (adds group settings + info). Previously every admin it made was missing mute/ban/kick rights in Telegram itself, even though the bot's own /mute, /ban, and /kick commands still worked for them - roles fix the native Telegram side too. It still never lets an admin it made add or remove other admins.

headline: Cricket, rock-paper-scissors, and a leaderboard are back
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Hand cricket

/cricket @username - one over each, text and buttons only, no images. Both pick 1-6 every ball; matching numbers means the batter is out. Highest total after both innings wins, and the chase ends the moment the target is passed.
Rock-paper-scissors
/rps @username - one round, pick your move and it resolves instantly.
Leaderboard
/lb shows wins/losses/draws for the last 3 days. /lb cricket or /lb rps shows match history with times, 5 per page - only 3 days of history is kept.
Rules to keep it clean

At most 3 matches of the same game run at once per group. An unaccepted challenge closes itself after 3 minutes; a match with no move for 5 minutes closes with no result recorded, so nothing sits open for days.

headline: Ask me anything
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: New /ask command

/ask [question] searches Wikipedia first for fast, accurate answers to established facts. If Wikipedia has nothing (recent events, obscure topics), it automatically falls back to web search. Returns a short answer (1-2 sentences max) with no links. Examples: /ask what is einstein's first name, /ask speed of light, /ask who won the world cup 2026.

headline: Activity tracking and giveaway system
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Activity Tracking

Every message is now counted per user on daily, weekly, and monthly bases. Use /top (or /top daily, /top weekly, /top monthly) to see the top 10 most active chatters. This data is used for giveaway participation requirements.
Giveaway System

Admins can now run giveaways with /giveaway <duration> <winners> <prize>. Examples: /giveaway 10m 1 iPad Pro, /giveaway 1h 2 Discord Nitro. Features include: multiple parallel giveaways with different timings, participation requirements (minimum messages, account age), instant winner announcements, reroll support (/greroll <giveaway_id>), cancel option (/gcancel by replying to giveaway message), and full history log (/ghistory) with winner and reroll information. Members join by clicking the 'Enter Giveaway' button.
Daily Zombie Scan Improvement

The daily deleted-account scan now asks for confirmation before kicking instead of auto-kicking. When zombies are found, you'll get a message with /zombies confirm to proceed. If no zombies are found, you'll see a 'no zombies found' message. This gives you more control over account cleanup.

headline: Giveaway and game improvements
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Giveaway Reroll Enhancement

/greroll now supports replying to the giveaway message, just like /gcancel. You no longer need to type the giveaway ID manually - simply reply to the finished giveaway message with /greroll to pick new winners.
Game Challenge Error Message

Improved error message when challenging someone who hasn't been seen by the bot. The message now clearly explains that you should either reply to their message or select their name from Telegram's @ suggestion menu, and that the person needs to have sent at least one message in the chat for the bot to find them.

headline: Cricket game major improvements
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Over Selection

Cricket now lets you choose 1, 2, or 3 overs when starting a match (default: 1 over = 6 balls each). Simply challenge someone, and you'll see buttons to select the number of overs before the match starts.
Better UI

Complete UI overhaul with clean table format, clear scoreboard, and batting/bowling information. The match message now shows who's batting, who's bowling, current ball, scores in a table format, and target information for innings 2.
Opponent Names

Instead of 'Waiting for the other pick', the bot now shows 'Waiting for [opponent name]...' so you know exactly who needs to pick. When you lock your pick, you'll see '✅ [Your name] locked in' followed by who's waiting.
Spam Protection

Added 500ms cooldown between button clicks to prevent laggy feeling when players tap too fast. You'll get a '⏳ Slow down! Wait a moment.' message if you click too quickly, making gameplay smoother and preventing accidental double-clicks.
Better Feedback

Instant feedback with emojis and clear status messages. When you lock a pick, you see '🔒 Locked: [number]'. When a ball is played, you see '⚡ [result]'. When match finishes, you see '✅ Match finished!' with winner announcement.

headline: Command name changes to avoid conflicts
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Activity Command Renamed

/top is now /active to avoid conflicts with other bots. Use /active (or /active daily, /active weekly, /active monthly) to see who's most active in the chat. This was causing the /top command to not work when another bot was responding to it first.
Game Leaderboard Command Renamed

/lb is now /gboard to avoid conflicts with other bots. Use /gboard to see overall game stats, or /gboard cricket and /gboard rps to see match history. The old /lb command was conflicting with other bots' leaderboard commands.
Bug Fix
Fixed /top command not working - it was calling a non-existent database function. The command now works correctly and has been renamed to /active.
